description: x402 service discovery: Finds paid x402 APIs for a task: keyword-matches your need against the Coinbase Bazaar discovery catalog (first 1,000 entries, cached 10 minutes) and returns matching resources with price, network, pay-to address and the seller's description, filterable by max price and network. Pair with x402.probe before paying anyone. Source: Coinbase Bazaar. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: results[]{resource, host, description, price_usd, network, pay_to, match_score}, scanned, catalog_total, coverage.

max_price_usd.description: only resources at or under this price (optional)

need.description: what the agent needs, in words (e.g. 'wallet balance base', 'web search', 'weather')

network.description: substring of a CAIP-2 network such as eip155:8453 or solana (optional)

name: x420_x402_discover
